units.source_text: 当伞女伏在地上，高兴的流出热泪的时候，她旁边的伞翁也高举双腕，不由得赞美天父大慈大悲。

en.t: When the umbrella woman lay face down on the ground, shedding hot tears of joy, the old umbrella man beside her also raised both arms high and could not help praising the boundless mercy of the Heavenly Father.

units.source_text: 与此同时，西美昂试图拯救火梁下面的罗连，飞也似的跑了过去，

en.t: At the same time, Simeon tried to save Loren from beneath the burning beam and ran over as if flying.

units.source_text: 伞翁的歌颂之词顿时改为祈祷之词，在空中飘荡。

en.t: The old umbrella man's words of praise at once changed into words of prayer and drifted through the air.

units.source_text: 在场的所有人跟随者齐声高呼：“主啊，求您保佑！”

en.t: Everyone present followed along and cried out in one voice, Lord, please protect him.

units.source_text: 就这样，圣母玛利亚的圣子，我主耶稣基督，以感同身受的心，倾听到了众人的呼吁，

en.t: Thus the holy son of the Virgin Mary, our Lord Jesus Christ, listened with a compassionate heart to the cries of the people.

units.source_text: 只见全身被烧焦的罗连，正被西美昂双臂抱着，从火场中的得救而归了。

en.t: Then they saw Loren, his whole body scorched, being carried in Simeon's arms, rescued and brought back from the fire.
